name: Ouji
source:
Job: Raccord owner
Type of Ayakashi: Domeki 100-eyed Demon
Signature Trait: Has 100 eyes all over his body, each one infused with special power.
Likes: Pretty ladies
Dislikes: Housework

The owner of Milk Hall Raccord (in name alone). This lazy man lets his employee, Aoi, handle 95% of the café’s workload. While Aoi's busy running the place, Oji chats with customers and takes smoke breaks that last hours. However, melancholy clings to this kind and fun-loving man... Painful memories of a past life hound him for reasons unknown...

[From [url=https://voltageapps.com/ayakashi/characters/detail-twilight-oji]English official site[/url]]
